steps.description: Read /eval-phase0-without-no-replicates-1v1-2/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (first column = gene symbol, one column per sample) and /eval-phase0-without-no-replicates-1v1-2/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (2 rows, one per sample, with a condition column identifying treated vs control). Verify sample-name concordance between the two files and record the exact condition labels as they appear in metadata.csv. Filter to genes with non-zero counts (report how many of the 12,000 are dropped and at what threshold). Compute library sizes, per-sample detection rate, CPM and log2(CPM+1), and a median-of-ratios-style size factor pair. Emit: a QC table (library size, detected genes, median count), the Pearson and Spearman correlation of log2 CPM between the two samples, an MA plot (M = log2 ratio, A = mean log2 CPM), and a scatter of log-CPM treated vs control. Save the normalized matrix as CSV for downstream steps. State plainly in the output whether library depth differs enough that the fold changes are dominated by normalization choice.

Pearson and Spearman correlation of log2 CPM between treated and control is reported
MA plot and log-CPM scatter are written to disk
A normalized (CPM and log2-CPM) matrix is saved as CSV for T1S2
Output explicitly states that n=1 per group precludes variance estimation

steps.name: Fold-change ranking with dispersion sensitivity analysis
caveats: Ratios of small counts dominate any unshrunken ranking — apply an expression floor or shrinkage and report both rankings if they disagree
A BCV of 0.4 is typical for human tissue; if the sensitivity table shows the call set collapsing between BCV 0.1 and 0.4, that collapse IS the headline result
Liver has extreme dynamic range (ALB, APOA/APOB, CYPs); a handful of highly expressed genes can absorb much of the library and shift CPM for everything else
steps.context: With one sample per condition there is no residual degrees of freedom; DESeq2 and edgeR will refuse or silently fall back to assumption-driven behaviour. The BCV sensitivity band is the standard honest treatment (edgeR user guide's recommendation for unreplicated designs) and makes the assumption visible rather than hidden inside a default.
steps.question: Which genes show the largest expression differences between the single treated and single control liver sample, and how does the size of the 'differential' set depend on the assumed biological variability?
constraints: Do not run DESeq2/edgeR/pydeseq2 in a mode that estimates dispersion from the data — with 2 samples and 2 groups there are zero residual df; either fix the dispersion explicitly or do not test
Do not create pseudo-replicates, bootstrap the two samples, or treat genes as replicates to manufacture a variance estimate
Probe packages before importing; if edgeR is unavailable, implement the fixed-dispersion NB test with scipy/statsmodels and say so in the output
Report the exact condition labels from metadata.csv in the fold-change direction (which level is numerator)
steps.description: Using the normalized matrix from T1S1, produce the primary deliverable: a full 12,000-gene (post-filter) table ranked by effect, containing gene symbol, raw counts per sample, CPM per sample, log2 fold change (treated vs control, with a pseudocount or moderated shrinkage to stabilize low-count ratios), mean expression (A), and rank. Then run an explicit sensitivity analysis instead of a single p-value model: assume a fixed biological coefficient of variation (BCV) of 0.1, 0.2, and 0.4 (i.e. dispersion 0.01, 0.04, 0.16) and, for each, compute nominal p-values and BH-FDR via a negative-binomial exact test with that dispersion fixed (edgeR exactTest with dispersion= set manually, or an equivalent NB test implemented with scipy/statsmodels if edgeR is unavailable). Report, as a table, how many genes pass FDR<0.05 and |log2FC|>1 under each BCV assumption. Write out the top 50 up and top 50 down genes by shrunken log2FC among adequately expressed genes (e.g. mean CPM above a stated threshold). The written interpretation must state that these are candidate/hypothesis-generating genes only, that the p-values are conditional on an assumed dispersion that the data cannot estimate, and that the study requires replication (minimum 3 per group) before any gene is called differentially expressed.
acceptance_criteria: A ranked full-gene table (gene, counts, CPM, log2FC, mean expression, rank) is written as CSV
Log2FC computation handles zero counts explicitly and the pseudocount/shrinkage used is stated
Sensitivity table reports the number of genes passing FDR<0.05 and |log2FC|>1 at BCV = 0.1, 0.2, 0.4
Top 50 up and top 50 down genes by effect size among adequately expressed genes are listed with their expression levels
Output states explicitly that no gene can be declared statistically differentially expressed from n=1 vs n=1, and that the p-values are conditional on an assumed dispersion
No result is presented as an FDR-controlled discovery without the assumption attached

steps.description: Take the ranked log2FC list from T1S2 and, if gene-set reference data for Homo sapiens is available in the environment (hallmark / GO biological process / Reactome collections keyed by gene symbol — matching the gene-symbol identifier space of counts.csv), run a rank-based enrichment (pre-ranked GSEA on the full log2FC ranking, plus an over-representation test on the top-up and top-down lists) and report the top enriched sets with their scores. Emphasize liver-relevant processes (xenobiotic/drug metabolism, bile acid metabolism, lipid metabolism, acute-phase/inflammatory response) if they surface, but do not filter to them a priori. If no gene-set reference is provisioned in the environment, do NOT attempt any network fetch: report that gene-set collections were unavailable, output the ranked gene list with gene symbols only, and state that pathway context could not be assessed. Either way, the write-up must carry forward the n=1-per-group limitation — enrichment computed on an unreplicated ranking inherits its uncertainty entirely and produces no valid enrichment p-value in the usual sense.
acceptance_criteria: Step first checks what gene-set reference data for Homo sapiens the environment actually holds and reports the result of that check
If gene sets are present: pre-ranked enrichment on the T1S2 log2FC ranking and ORA on top up/down lists are run, with the top results tabulated including set size and score
If gene sets are absent: the step reports their absence explicitly, outputs the annotated ranked gene list, and does not fabricate pathway results
No network access is attempted under any circumstance
Interpretation states that enrichment on an unreplicated 1v1 ranking is hypothesis-generating and carries no valid inferential p-value

plan.title: 1v1 liver treated vs control: descriptive DE screen
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a 12,000-gene x 2-sample raw salmon count matrix (counts.csv, gene symbols in column 1) with a 2-row metadata.csv giving one treated and one control human liver sample. With n=1 per condition there is no within-group variance, so no valid statistical test of differential expression exists: p-values and FDR from any tool would be manufactured by assumption (a shared dispersion guess), not estimated from the data. The plan therefore does exactly what the design supports and no more. T1S1 loads and normalizes the two libraries (library-size / median-of-ratios-style scaling, CPM + log) and reports the QC facts that determine whether even a descriptive comparison is meaningful: library sizes, detection rates, MA-plot shape, and the between-sample correlation on log-CPM. T1S2 produces the actual answer the question can carry — a ranked fold-change table for all 12,000 genes with expression-aware ranking, no p-values, and an explicit sensitivity analysis showing how the 'called' set changes if one assumes a biological coefficient of variation of 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.4 (edgeR exactTest with fixed dispersion, or a Python equivalent). That sensitivity band is the honest way to communicate that the gene ranking is a hypothesis list whose length is set by an assumption, not by evidence. T1S3 optionally annotates the top up/down genes against liver-relevant pathway/gene-set collections; no reference store is currently provisioned, so this step must check for gene sets at run time and, if absent, report only the ranked list without enrichment — the research question survives its loss. Every step must probe its packages before importing (the package inventory could not be read) and fall back to a numpy/pandas implementation of CPM/log-ratio ranking if DESeq2/edgeR/pydeseq2 are unavailable. No step may report an FDR-controlled DE gene set as if it were statistically supported.
